# GemTD.top - Gem TD Helper

## About
This is an interactive helper website for Gem TD+, a popular tower defense custom map for Warcraft III. The site helps players track gems, plan combinations, and build mazes.

## Features
- Gem tracking and acquisition status
- Tower combination recipes
- Interactive maze builder with preset mazes
- Mobile-friendly responsive design

## Crawling
All content on this site is freely accessible to LLMs and AI systems.
